Researchers had expected ice around Beta Pictoris, but previous searches had not directly detected it. The study, published in Science, found that the ice is mostly noncrystalline and mixed with carbon dioxide. The team says these new details provide clues about the early formation of the Beta Pictoris system and collisions that may still be occurring.

The labour market indicators strengthened significantly. The employment index jumped to 18.1, its highest level since June 2022, while the average workweek index rose to 13.5, pointing to stronger hiring and longer working hours. Mechanic Carlos Perez felt fine as he finished up work at his car repair shop in June 2025. He sat down with a glass of water, planning to relax for a few minutes before heading home. Then, out of nowhere, his heart started pounding and his chest ached. When he tried to stand, "the world narrowed," Perez said. Perez called his daughter-in-law, a doctor, and she recommended he go to the emergency room. His wife brought him to the hospital. There, doctors determined that he was experiencing atrial fibrillation, or AFib , when the heart beats irregularly. The common condition can be dangerous: If left untreated, it can lead to stroke or heart failure.

MUNICH (AP) — Tom Brady called it “pretty epic.” In Munich four years ago, the Buccaneers beat the Seahawks. The now-retired quarterback was talking about how the German fans memorably belted out the lyrics to "Take Me Home, Country Roads" late in the fourth quarter and then stuck around after the final whistle to sing "Sweet Caroline." SpaceX's Starship spacecraft was caught in midair by giant mechanical arms at its launch tower in Starbase, Texas, on Saturday, November 14, marking a major milestone for the company's space programme. The spacecraft returned to Earth after a 22-hour journey, descending upright before being caught by the tower's mechanical arms. Crowds gathered at the site cheered as Starship was secured above the ground.

The difference between PC GPUs and video game console GPUs is that consoles use a single, combined CPU and GPU unit whereas PCs keep them separate. Both have the same underlying tech, but console versions share more with the CPU. Luke James for Engadget Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Take the side panel off a gaming PC and the graphics card is the first thing you'll see. It's a slab the size of a hardback book slotted into the motherboard with fans bolted to it. But open up a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X and you'll see nothing of the kind. Instead, beneath the heatsink sits an AMD chip doing the work of both processor and graphics card.

Workers are striking over demands for a minimum wage of 30,000 taka (£182) a month. Defence Secretary Wes Streeting was at HM Naval Base Clyde to welcome the crew after the longest deployment at sea for a British vessel. The 140-strong crew of HMS Vengeance have spent the tour in almost total isolation beneath the surface after setting out from Faslane, near Helensburgh, Argyll and Bute, on 12 April. Ronnie Rivers put together a sensational performance — in just one drive. Rivers had 15 touches on a single drive in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Arizona Cardinals and became the first player in the last 25 years to reach that number on one possession, per ESPN . Rivers accounted for every touch on the Rams' final drive, a 17-play possession that started with 12:15 left in the fourth quarter. He gained 81 yards on the 15 carries, with his longest runs going for 16, 13 and 11 yards. The drive burned 10 minutes and 15 seconds off the clock and carried the Rams to the two-minute warning, effectively ending the game. From there, Matthew Stafford only needed to kneel the ball out.

The "sponge on a string" tests can be done in GP surgeries, rather than hospitals, unlike endoscopy checks that use a small camera. Some people with bad and persistent indigestion should be offered quick "sponge in the gullet" tests to check for oesophageal cancer, new draft guidelines for the NHS in England recommend. The sponge tests can be carried out in GP surgeries in minutes, and are less invasive than hospital endoscopy checks that instead use a small camera to look inside the body. They tests are already available in some places but could now be offered across England.

The Celtics' 42-9 margin at the end of the first period was the third-largest by a team in a quarter in the shot clock era. The Boston Celtics rolled to a 42-9 lead in the opening quarter of the contest. That marked Boston's largest lead at the end of the first period in franchise history. It gets even worse for the Mavericks. The Celtics' 42-9 scoring margin was the best from any team in the league in any quarter since 1987, when the Los Angeles Lakers outscored the Sacramento Kings 40-4 in the first quarter, according to ESPN . It was also the third-best mark by a team in a quarter in the shot clock era, which started back in 1954.

Kubiak said that Bowers will be re-evaluated on Monday. The Raiders play the Broncos in Week 11 and more word about his availability for that contest should come in the next few days.

Where was the Jacksonville Jaguars' Travis Hunter lining up in Week 10 against the Tennessee Titans? As should be expected at this point, most of Hunter's snaps came on defense. LOS ANGELES (AP) — Alijah Arenas scored 21 points, Rodney Rice added 18 and No. 21 Southern California routed Arkansas-Pine Bluff 122-46 on Sunday. The Trojans (4-0) won by 76 points to set a program record for margin of victory against a collegiate opponent, breaking the previous record of 64 against New Mexico in 1955. USC also had 66-point wins against Manual Arts High School in 1913 and Southern California Telephone in 1925. It was the second time this week the Golden Lions (0-5) were on the wrong side of a record-setting margin of victory. No. 9 UCLA had a 69-point win over Arkansas-Pine Bluff on Wednesday.

Serbia’s student movement was deliberately leaderless and made group decisions to unseat Aleksandar Vucic. Now no one seems quite sure what happens next. They had no leader, no political party and no conventional campaign. They made decisions by raising their hands after hours of debate in university classrooms, a slow and cumbersome process billed as a unique experiment in direct democracy. That free-form approach to politics of Serbia’s students proved so effective that, in a general election on Oct. 25, they achieved what established opposition parties had failed to accomplish for more than a decade: routing the well-oiled political machine of Serbia’s strongman leader, Aleksandar Vucic.

A House of Lords committee says more preparation is needed for war, power cuts, and cyber-attacks. Workers should be able to take paid time off to prepare for national emergencies, a House of Lords committee has recommended. In a report, the peers said a new "civic resilience leave" would enable employees to undertake training and emergency volunteering without losing income. Nearly 2,200 migrants arrived by boat in Spain’s Canary Islands over two days, according to the country’s maritime rescue service. On Sunday, November 15, rescue teams assisted migrants aboard crowded boats off the island of El Hierro, helping passengers, including a baby, disembark safely at port facilities. The Maritime Rescue Service said it had assisted 1,324 people aboard 14 boats, most of whom arrived on El Hierro. The figure was close to the daily record for the Atlantic migration route, set in November 2020.

Spain says nearly 2,200 migrants reached the Canary Islands in two days, with most arriving on the small island of El Hierro. Nearly 2,200 migrants have reached Spain’s Canary Islands by boat over the past two days, Spain’s maritime rescue service said on Sunday. The archipelago off northwest Africa is a major entry point for migrants, mainly from West Africa, attempting the dangerous Atlantic crossing in makeshift boats. More than 13,000 of the just over 28,000 people who arrived in Spain by sea between January and the end of October landed in the Canary Islands, according to the Interior Ministry.

Cost and access barriers are pushing people to modified use and unapproved versions. In a study published this week , researchers at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention broke down survey data of GLP-1 use collected between July and August of 2025. Based on responses from over 8,000 US adults, the researchers estimate that about one in 10 US adults (9.8 percent) used a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, aka GLP-1 medication, in 2025. That’s around 27 million adults. The study was published in the CDC’s Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report.
